name: @w6w-apps/cognitoforms
description: Read Cognito Forms' forms and schemas, and create, read, update and delete form entries via the Cognito Forms REST API.

w6w.longDescription:
Cognito Forms is an online form builder for data collection, workflow automation and payments. This app covers the day-to-day work of running a form once it's published: list the forms an integration can see, read a form's schema to learn what fields an entry accepts, then create, read, update and delete individual entries against that schema.

Beyond entries, it covers the bulk-import lifecycle (upload a spreadsheet of entries and poll the import's status), reading a generated entry document or an uploaded file back out, uploading a new file for attachment to an entry, and toggling a form's public link availability window.

A fit for routing new form submissions into another system, keeping a form's data in sync with a downstream store, bulk-loading historical records, or pausing a form's public link during a maintenance window — without needing the form-building capabilities that stay in Cognito Forms' own designer.
